customer_name: Wuhan Tong Technology Co., Ltd. (武汉通科技有限公司)
business_problem: Wuhan Tong Technology needed to help severely understaffed grassroots government teams serve large resident populations, answer policy questions more accurately and automate labor-intensive work-order handling across community service scenarios.
solution_summary: Wuhan Tong Technology Co., Ltd. used Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan stack to build a grassroots government assistant spanning district, street and community operations. On the resident side, the team used Qianfan AppBuilder roles, follow-up prompts, speech recognition and Online-Search to expose consultation through WeChat groups, personal assistants, mini-programs, official accounts and H5 endpoints. Government policies and files were consolidated into a knowledge base so the assistant could answer common questions locally and fall back to controlled online search when standard content was missing. On the staff side, AppBuilder, ModelBuilder, NLP, Workflow and GBI convert patrol notes, dispute visits and daily resident conversations into structured forms and work orders, then route, review, feed back, evaluate and close cases against government procedures. The implementation also ingests crawled governance information to support intelligent analysis and category-based dispatching.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the orchestration layer for resident consultation, prompt logic, speech recognition integration and service-channel delivery.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports the custom model and NLP logic used to interpret government-service intents and normalize staff inputs.

solution_components.name: Government Knowledge Base
solution_components.role: Stores local policies and official files so answers can be grounded in region-specific government knowledge.

solution_components.name: Workflow
solution_components.role: Automates node judgment, routing and the work-order lifecycle from creation through closure.

solution_components.name: Resident Assistant
solution_components.role: Delivers citizen-facing consultation through chat groups, mini-programs, official accounts and H5 channels.

solution_components.name: Government Service Copilot
solution_components.role: Helps grassroots staff convert field observations and resident conversations into structured government work orders.

data_flow: Resident questions enter through WeChat groups, mini-programs, official accounts and H5 clients into the Resident Assistant on AppBuilder. The system answers from the local government knowledge base first, then uses controlled online search when standard content is missing. Staff-side text and voice inputs pass through ModelBuilder and NLP into normalized forms and work orders, which Workflow routes through review, feedback, evaluation and closure.
business_outcome: The deployment gave local governments a 24/7 resident assistant and automated work-order handling, helping Wuhan Tong deliver smarter public-service software while improving frontline efficiency, speeding resident responses and raising satisfaction.
